design_philosophy: A warm, sacred-yet-modern design that feels calming and trustworthy. Reverent, spiritually grounded, but contemporary. Avoiding 'churchy/kitschy' tropes.

typography.import_instruction: Import Outfit, Figtree, and Cormorant Garamond from Google Fonts.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing: p-6, p-8, p-12. Airy layouts to reduce cognitive load, crucial for anxiety relief.
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards/buttons to avoid sharp, stressful edges.
layout_and_spacing.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for sticky headers and audio player controls to feel premium and light.

components.buttons: Generous padding (py-4 px-8), fully rounded (rounded-full), soft transitions.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), rounded-3xl, soft hover lift.
components.sos_button: Prominent, circular, pulsing animation, using accent_sos color. Safe, non-alarming.
components.emotion_selector: Horizontal scrollable chips, rounded-full, soft pastels based on emotion (e.g., soft blue for calm, soft amber for anxious).
components.bottom_nav: Fixed to bottom, bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md, border-t border-gray-100, flex justify-around py-4.

screens.auth: Clean JWT auth screens (Sign In, Sign Up, Welcome). Minimalist, calming background image or soft gradient. Clear inputs.
screens.onboarding: Smooth multi-step flow (Welcome -> Name -> Faith Journey -> Concerns -> Notification -> Paywall). Use framer-motion for cross-fades. Minimal text per screen.
screens.home: Greeting with name. Big 'How are you feeling?' horizontal scrollable emotion chips. Large SOS panic button in center or top right. Daily devotional card. Bottom tab navigation.
screens.audio_player: Full screen, abstract soft pastel blur background (image or CSS), rotating album art or soft pulsing circle, play/pause controls, progress bar.
screens.prayer_library: Categorized grid (Morning, Evening, Anxiety). Floating Action Button or banner for AI Prayer Generator.
screens.ai_prayer_generator: Simple chat-like or form UI where user inputs feeling and receives a custom scripture-based prayer. Output displayed in serif font.
screens.journal: Simple text input area, mood tags, list of past entries with soft dates.
screens.profile: Stats grid (streak, minutes meditated, prayers completed), clean and un-cluttered.
screens.paywall: Premium features list with checkmarks, annual vs monthly toggle, high-contrast primary CTA using 'paywall_premium' accent.

motion.page_transitions: Soft fade and gentle slide up (duration: 0.4s) using framer-motion.
motion.interactions: Scale down slightly on press (scale: 0.98), hover lift for cards (-translate-y-1).
motion.breathing_exercise: Pulsing circle scaling up and down to match 4-7-8 breathing pattern (inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s). Includes textual cues.

images.description: Abstract, pastel colors and flowing shapes.
Sea under white clouds at golden hour. Use for peace/calm categories.
Green trees in forest during morning. Use for morning prayer/meditation.
Silhouette of cross under orange sky. Use for evening/deep faith categories.
Silhouette photo of person praying during sunrise. Use for daily devotional.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a mobile web app interface using React and Tailwind. Use a max-w-md mx-auto container with min-h-screen to simulate a mobile app frame if viewing on desktop.
Implement bottom tab navigation (Home, Prayers, Meditate, Journal, Profile) fixed to the bottom of the screen.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sos-button', data-testid='emotion-chip-anxious').
Use framer-motion for the breathing exercise (SOS panic button), creating a smooth expanding and contracting circle. Include visual text instructions (Inhale, Hold, Exhale).
For the scripture text in daily devotionals, use the 'Cormorant Garamond' serif font to give a reverent, Bible-like aesthetic, contrasting with the clean sans-serif UI.
Never use pure black; use text-primary (#1F2937) for main text. Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards.
Mock the authentication and paywall flows using state transitions. Make sure the paywall looks premium with subtle gold accents.
The UI should feel extremely light, airy, and unburdening. Avoid harsh lines, deep shadows, or cluttered information.
